senses.gloss: f. (עזב, v. infra) a concrete of stone chippings. clay &c., used for paving floors, pavement covering the ceiling (תִּקְרָה) of the lower story and serving as flooring to the upper story.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:2">B. Mets. X, 2</cite> <he>התחתון … העליון את המ׳</he> the dweller below must provide the ceiling, and the one above the pavement.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117a:11">Ib. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ אחזוקי וכ׳</he> the plaster preserves the ceiling (thus benefitting the owner of the lower story); (oth. opin.) <he>מ׳ אשוויי וכ׳</he> it serves only to level the floor.

Succ. I, 7 תקרה שאין עליה מ׳ a ceiling not covered with pavement; a. fr.—[עזב, Neh. III, 8 is supposed to mean: to form a concrete for fortification purposes.—Our w. seems to be a hebraization of מלט caementum (v. P. Sm. 2137), by confounding it with h. r. מָלַט; cmp. הִימְלְטָא a. מַלְטֵט.]
